title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Job Title: Agricultural Accounts Assistant
Location: Exeter (Hybrid)
Salary: Competitive (DOE)

Overview:
We are working with a well-established and highly regarded accountancy practice in the South West, currently looking to recruit an Agricultural Accounts Assistant to join their growing team in Exeter. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a supportive firm with a strong reputation and a diverse client base, particularly within the agricultural sector.

Key Responsibilities:
- Assisting in the preparation of financial statements for a varied portfolio of clients
- Supporting with bookkeeping duties, including processing invoices and payments
- Performing bank and account reconciliations
- Liaising with clients to obtain information and provide updates
- Working with accounting software such as Xero, Sage, and QuickBooks
- Collaborating with wider teams to deliver a high-quality service

Requirements:
- AAT qualified or part-qualified, or studying towards ACA/ACCA
- Previous experience within an accountancy practice is desirable
- Strong IT skills, including Excel and accounting software
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills
- Strong communication skills and ability to build client relationships
- Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
- An interest in or exposure to the agricultural sector would be advantageous

Benefits:
- Competitive salary (DOE)
- Study support (if applicable)
- Hybrid working options
- Supportive and collaborative working environment
- Opportunities for long-term career progression

If this sounds like a great opportunity then please click Apply today. Alternatively contact Jasmine Dorel /(url removed)

title: HR Coordinator
description:
HR Coordinator
- Salary: £14.18 - £16.37 p/h
- Temporary (3-month assignment, likely to be extended)
- Location: Exeter
- Full time, 35.25 hours per week
- Start Date: ASAP

Reed is currently seeking a proactive and experienced HR Coordinator / Generalist for a client based in Exeter. This temporary role is an excellent opportunity for an individual who can hit the ground running, offering a potential extension beyond the initial 3-month period. The position requires a strong knowledge of HR practices.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Implement HR strategies that support business objectives.
- Forge strong relationships across the organisation to ensure a seamless HR service.
- Handle various HR projects and responsibilities with a generalist scope.
- Ensure compliance with employment laws and company policies.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Strong generalist HR experience.
- Experience is preferred over formal qualifications, though CIPD is desirable.
- Must be able to adapt quickly and effectively in a dynamic environment.
- Robust knowledge of HR practices and employment law.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Benefits:
- Initially office-based for training and integration, transitioning to a hybrid working pattern with 2 days at home and 2 days in the office per week.
- Opportunity to work within a dynamic team and contribute significantly to various HR functions.

To apply for this HR Coordinator position, please submit your CV today! Please contact Emma Hutchings at the Reed Devon & Cornwall office for further information.

title: Project Coordinator - Exeter
company: Build Maintain Recruit Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Join a Team That's Passionate About Property!
We're looking for an enthusiastic, organised and proactive Portfolio Property Coordinator to join an ambitious and friendly team in Exeter.
They don't just manage properties but are constantly looking for ways to improve, invest and create exceptional places for our tenants, guests and businesses. Their portfolio spans residential, commercial and holiday properties, making every day different and every challenge rewarding.
So, what's it all about?
This is a varied, hands-on position combining property management, facilities coordination and lease administration. You'll play a key role in keeping our portfolio running smoothly by coordinating maintenance, supporting tenants, managing contractors and ultimately, ensuring the properties remain safe, compliant and well maintained.
And better yet, you will be making a genuine impact!
What You'll Be Doing
- Coordinating planned and reactive maintenance
- Building positive relationships with tenants, contractors and suppliers.
- Managing property records, lease documentation and compliance requirements.
- Monitoring maintenance budgets and contractor performance.
- Supporting property acquisitions, disposals and improvement projects.
- Producing reports and identifying opportunities to improve processes and efficiency.
- Helping ensure the properties continue to provide an excellent experience for tenants and guests.

About You
I am looking to speaking to people are match up with the following:
- Naturally organised with excellent attention to detail.
- A confident communicator who enjoys building strong relationships.
- Proactive and resourceful, with a positive, can-do attitude.
- Comfortable juggling multiple priorities in a varied role.
- Keen to learn, develop and continuously improve.
- Confident using digital systems and happy working with data and documentation.
- Passionate about delivering outstanding customer service.

Previous property experience is beneficial, but just as important is your attitude, willingness to learn and ability to adapt. If you're someone who enjoys taking ownership and making things happen, you'll fit right in.
Why Join Us?
You'll become part of a collaborative, ambitious team that genuinely enjoys working together. No two days are the same, and you'll have the chance to work across a diverse property portfolio while developing your skills in a supportive environment.
What more could you want?!
If you're looking for a career where you can grow, be challenged and work alongside a passionate team that genuinely cares about what they do, then look no further!
Apply today and I can talk through this exciting position in much more detail!

title: Temporary Receptionist / Front of House
description:
Job Title: Temporary Receptionist / Front of House

Location: Exeter City Centre
Salary: 12.71 per hour
Hours: Full Time, Temporary

Key Benefits Include:
- Weekly pay.
- Convenient city centre location.
- Immediate start available.
- Friendly and professional working environment.
- Opportunity to gain valuable office experience.
- Potential for ongoing temporary assignments.

We are currently seeking a professional and personable Receptionist to join a busy office in Exeter City Centre on a temporary basis.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys meeting and greeting visitors, delivering exceptional customer service and being the face of a business. The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring the reception area operates smoothly and visitors receive a warm and professional welcome.

The ideal candidate will be organised, confident communicating with a range of people and able to manage multiple tasks within a busy office environment.

- Managing incoming calls and directing enquiries appropriately.
- Maintaining a professional and welcoming reception area.
- Handling incoming and outgoing post.
- Booking meeting rooms and coordinating appointments.
- Providing administrative support to the wider team.
- Managing email enquiries and correspondence.
- Assisting with office coordination duties as required.
- Updating internal records and databases accurately.
- Preparing, scanning and filing documentation.
- Supporting the team with general administrative tasks.
- Ensuring a high standard of customer service is delivered at all times.

About You:

Essential
- Previous reception, front of house, administration or customer service experience.
- Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
- Professional and friendly telephone manner.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Confident using Microsoft Office applications.
- Ability to multitask and prioritise workload effectively.
- Reliable, punctual and professional.

Ready to Make an Impact?

If you're an experienced Receptionist, Administrator or Front of House professional looking for your next temporary opportunity, we'd love to hear from you.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a welcoming team and make an immediate contribution within a professional office environment.

title: Trainee Administrator
description:
If you are looking to work for a growing business who truly value and care for their employees, then look no further!
Aureos are seeking a Trainee Administrator to join our infrastructure team in Exeter. Working as part of a small team, you will provide administrative support and/or customer services, ensuring all tasks are fulfilled in accordance with quality standards and budget requirements.
Duties/Responsibilities
Promotion of Health and Safety policy
- Promote the Company's Health and Safety policy and ensure safe working practices are maintained at all times
- Act as a Coordinator to empower the leadership team on management of SHE returns (including monthly collation of depot and regional returns and uploading of information to SharePoint with finalised figures for Aureos).

General Administrative Procedures
- Working as part of a small team, coordinate and provide a full range of administrative support and/or customer services to ensure deadlines, quality standards and budget requirements are achieved.
- Assist in organising team and/or regional team meetings, arrange lunches, take notes and distribute minutes as required.
- Take personal ownership of accountability areas and problem solving and, where applicable, facilitate this within the team to ensure all issues are satisfactorily resolved at the lowest possible level.
- Working with Aureos systems, manage job raising, invoicing, asset management, these duties are not exhaustive.
- Perform other ad-hoc duties as required by Operations teams with guidance on areas of responsibility from Operations Managers, Regional Directors and Lead Admin.

Performance and Resourcing
- Working flexibly and as applicable, coordinate the operations team to ensure a high level of performance and best utilisation of resources in accordance with quality standards and budget requirements (i.e. Labour Programme coordination role); Manage fleet allocations to operational staff.

Document preparation
- Produce documents, briefing papers and presentations for Regional Directors, Operations Managers, Project Managers and Technicians as may be required; Prepare agendas and pre-meeting briefings.

Timesheet recording
- You will be responsible for inputting the information from the operational employees' details from their timesheets to our central online system.

Implementation tracking
- Attend project meetings as required, distribute post meeting actions to the team and track their completion.

Reporting and Correspondence
- Manage (State of Electricity Access Report) SEAR reporting and housekeeping of the system; Coordinate the collation of data and preparation of reports, schedules, summaries and correspondence as necessary (including organising of key reports e.g. weekly reports for Operations Managers/Regional Directors on Lead Indicators, Permits to Drive, outstanding debt, etc.).

Training and Development
- Coordinate the implementation of approved training plans (including one-to-one coaching as necessary) to ensure the provision of the required service in a resource efficient and cost-effective manner.

Storage of Information
- Maintain storage of company information in line with GDPR regulations.

Continuous Improvement
- Identify opportunities to enhance admin service and reduce costs by continuous improvement of processes and practices.

Occupational Health Management
- Oversee booking and organisation of Occupational Health Checks, referrals, issues, work change requirements etc.

Fleet/vehicle management
- Manage fleet availability, allocation and reliability. Manage fleet allocations to operational staff, bookings for servicing/maintenance work and hire vehicles.

Knowledge, skills and experience
- Good literacy skills.
- Good communication skills (listens; welcomes feedback).
- Good time management and organisation skills.
- Ability to prioritise and coordinate tasks.
- Analytical and systematic approach to problem solving.
- Able to use own initiative.
- Contributes to effective team working.
- Able to work flexibly and contribute as part of a team.
- Attention to detail and accuracy.
- Commitment to continuous improvement.

In return you will receive
- Generous Salary
- 25 days Holiday with the option to buy more
- Pension
- Cycle to work scheme
- Free parking
- Health & wellbeing programme
- Employee benefits portal.
- On-site parking
- Private medical insurance
- Referral Scheme

Equal Opportunities
Aureos are an equal opportunities employer and we are determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions or requirements which cannot be shown to be justifiable.
Whether you are looking for progression in your new role or for your forever job, we will happily welcome your application.

title: Service Administrator
company: Royal Devon University Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust
advertiser_name: Royal Devon University Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust
description: The post holder will support the Administration Line Managers/Service Coordinators by Co-ordinating a professional, efficient and effective administrative service to patients and visitors in accordance with Trust policies and standards The role will coordinate and organise the attendance of patients to outpatient, inpatient & day case appointments in line with local team and Trust arrangements as instructed Ensure all administrative processes; and enquiries are dealt with in an efficient and timely manner, following agreed standard operating procedures, escalating to senior manager as appropriate Undertake general clerical duties to maximise all available capacity in an appropriate way Proof reading clinical letters (please note there is no audio typing in this role) Monitoring waiting times, ensuring that our patients treatment pathways, from referral to treatment are accurate and up to date (for more information on what this means please visit - NHS England Referral to treatment) Ensure all information is secure and confidentiality of information is maintained at all times Provide excellent customer care which may include communica For more detail about the main duties of this role, please see the job description section below. As a key member of the Royal Devon University Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust, you will be joining an exceptional team working together to help our patients to stay healthy, when they need it most. For more information on the Job Description and Responsibilities please click the link below. More detail about the role We are looking to recruit an enthusiastic and motivated Service Administrator to join the Princess Elizabeth Orthopaedic Centre. The successful candidate must be highly motivated with excellent communication skills, enjoy working within a busy and vibrant team. They must be able to prioritise their workload and able to work well under pressure. Secretarial experience, knowledge of working in a hospital environment and medical terminology are all desirable for this role, but not essential. You will have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, and proven experience in dealing with service users on the telephone. You will be flexible and adaptable with excellent IT skills. You will need to enjoy the challenge of working as part of a busy team yet have the ability to use your own initiative to meet the changing needs of the department and Orthopaedic service as a whole. If you feel you would be able to meet the demands of this challenging and rewarding role, then we would be delighted to hear from you. Visits to the department are welcome and encouraged. Working Pattern: 37.5 hours a week Monday- Friday between 08.00-17.00 Interview Date: 25th September For further information please contact: For more information and to arrange informal visits, please contact the Admin Line Manager Team on 01392 403569 or email rduh.peoc.alms@nhs.net This is a fixed term contract for 12 months. For current NHS employees this post could be a secondment opportunity. As an inclusive employer, the Royal Devon values diversity and is committed to creating a culture of inclusivity where everyone can be themselves and reach their full potential. We believe in fostering a sense of belonging and actively encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, cultures, and abilities. We recognise the advantages of having a diverse workforce that reflects the communities we serve. Preference will be given to staff with Priority and 'At Risk' status including NHS At Risk staff throughout Devon. The Royal Devon University Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust reserves the right to close vacancy when sufficient applications have been received. The Royal Devon University Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust was established in April 2022, bringing together the expertise of both the Royal Devon and Exeter NHS Foundation Trust and Northern Devon Healthcare NHS Trust. Benefits We will work together to maintain a culture that develops and supports you and your team. This might include funding for a care certificate, a degree or leadership qualifications. Or it might include days off to study, engage in CPD or rotational placements to help you hone your skills. Wherever you are heading in the NHS, we'll help you get there. Looking after you is important to us. We strive to help our staff create a healthy work-life balance through flexible working schemes and our family friendly policies. If you're starting out in the NHS, you'll start with 27 days paid annual leave (plus bank holidays), rising to 33 days plus bank holidays. You'll benefit from access to our own comprehensive occupational health services, including counselling, onsite wellbeing activities and groups. Salary is not the only financial benefit You'll have access to an extensive range of staff discounts on shopping, fitness and leisure options and you can spread the cost of technology and home appliance purchases from major retailers. You will also have access to other benefits including: National discount services such as the Blue Light Card and Health Service Discounts. Salary sacrifice options including our OFSTED rated outstanding nursery onsite at Exeter Car lease schemes. The NHS Pension scheme (one of the most generous and comprehensive in the UK). Cycle to work scheme These are just a few of the benefits available if the role is something you are interested in, we'd love to hear from you.
